tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background (dark roast). Every screen sits on it.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, rows, fields and tiles on bg. Separation comes from this step, never from borders.

tokens.name: surface-sheet
tokens.usage: Bottom-sheet background (More, Add your own feature, New step).

tokens.name: surface-sheet-field
tokens.usage: Fields, rows and cards inside a sheet.

tokens.name: control
tokens.usage: Stepper −/+ buttons and inactive chips on surface; faint chart grid lines.

tokens.name: control-strong
tokens.usage: Stepper buttons on surface-sheet-field.

tokens.name: nav
tokens.usage: Bottom tab bar background.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Dims the screen behind a bottom sheet; tapping it closes the sheet.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and values on bg and surfaces (14:1 on bg).

tokens.name: ink-soft
tokens.usage: Finding sentences on insight cards; step labels on −/+ buttons.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Labels, units, captions, inactive tab labels (7:1 on bg, 6:1 on surface).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Dashed preview frames, dashed 'add' chips, connector lines, secondary chart marks.

tokens.name: cream
tokens.usage: Used sparingly for the ONE thing that should stand out on a page: roast-age block, My setup card, selected tab in a segmented control, Default chip, duplicate-finder card.

tokens.name: on-cream
tokens.usage: Text on cream.

tokens.name: on-cream-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on cream (6.6:1).

tokens.name: amber
tokens.usage: Crema amber — YOUR INPUT AND ACTIONS: primary button, +, Add buttons, selected score/chip/segment, slider handles, switches, tappable secondary values, score data in charts. Never decoration.

tokens.name: on-amber
tokens.usage: Text and icons on amber (9:1).

tokens.name: sage
tokens.usage: Sage leaf — CHANGED SINCE LAST SHOT: changed values and delta pills. Nothing else.

tokens.name: on-sage
tokens.usage: Text on sage delta pills.

tokens.name: cherry
tokens.usage: Coffee cherry — RECIPE HISTORY: recipe tag (filled dot = reused, hollow = new), previous-score marker, recipe-change lines in graphs, 'Same as before'. Nothing else.

tokens.name: bean
tokens.usage: Logo only: the bean.

tokens.name: bean-crease
tokens.usage: Logo only: the bean's crease.

tokens.name: chart-grid
tokens.usage: Chart grid lines and axes: faint, recessive.

tokens.name: chart-secondary
tokens.usage: Non-highlighted bars, histogram bars, reference marks.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Tab page titles: Library, Journal, Insights.

styles.name: value-xl
styles.usage: Core values on the shot form (grind, dose, yield, time). Always tabular numbers.

styles.name: value-l
styles.usage: Values in Edit My setup tiles and stat tiles.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Screen titles in the header of task screens.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Card titles, insight findings, routine names.

styles.name: section
styles.usage: Section headings inside a screen or sheet; row labels.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Half of your natural shots score 8 or more.
styles.usage: Running text. Inputs use 16px so phones do not zoom.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Field labels, metadata lines, chip counts. Color ink-muted.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Chart footnotes, units, hints. Never below 12px.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap inside segmented controls; between a label and its value.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between chips and between −/+ buttons.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between cards and sections on a screen (the default rhythm).

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Screen side gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Bottom padding under the primary button (thumb room).

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: −/+ buttons, score buttons, segment items.

tokens.name: radius-block
tokens.usage: Small blocks inside a card: flavor note chips on the shot detail, the best-score block on recipe rows, the shot form bean card's icon tile.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Fields, list rows, setup rows, segmented track.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and the primary button.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Insight cards, Library rows, preview frames.

tokens.name: radius-sheet
tokens.usage: Top corners of bottom sheets.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Chips, pills, delta pills, switches, the + button.

tokens.name: touch-min
tokens.usage: Minimum touch target for anything tappable.

tokens.name: button-primary-h
tokens.usage: Height of the full-width primary button.

tokens.name: field-h
tokens.usage: Minimum height of a labelled field or picker.

tokens.name: tabbar-h
tokens.usage: Bottom tab bar height including the 16px bottom safe area, as the screens draw it (84px of bar plus 16px).

tokens.name: plus-button
tokens.usage: Diameter of the center + (new shot) button.

tokens.name: viewport-ref-w
tokens.usage: Reference phone width (Google Pixel 8a).

tokens.name: viewport-ref-h
tokens.usage: Reference phone height (Google Pixel 8a).

meta.source: Coffee Nerd UX canvas and docs/ux-decision-log.md (D-01 to D-57), 2026-10-16
